sources.title: SSC previous year question paper page
sources.use: official/open PYQ discovery when downloadable without login

sources.title: SSC answer key page
sources.use: answer key discovery only; candidate response sheets stay private

sources.title: Scribd SSC CGL books, papers, and study documents
sources.use: resource discovery, bibliography, and manual review only
sources.acquisition: link and metadata only unless the user supplies a rights-cleared PDF or explicit permission
sources.publishPolicy: do not copy paid, login-gated, or copyright-risk document text into the public corpus

sources.title: Third-party SSC CGL web PDF collections
sources.use: candidate discovery for OCR/import review queue
sources.acquisition: link, title, source page, and provenance metadata first; file import only after rights and answer-key review
sources.publishPolicy: do not copy unverified book or coaching-bank text; only reviewed metadata and original explanations may be published

sources.title: Third-party SSC CGL PYQ collection lanes
sources.use: wide PYQ lead discovery for missing years and shifts
sources.acquisition: Scrapling collects public link metadata; direct PDFs or solved-paper pages stay quarantined unless rights, provenance, OCR, answer-key, topic, duplicate, and agent-review gates pass
sources.publishPolicy: do not copy coaching-site or book text into public notes; use links as provenance-visible leads and generate only original explanations

sources.title: Original practice/topic coverage lanes
sources.use: coverage-gap discovery for topic drills and original practice generation
sources.acquisition: Scrapling collects topic/link metadata only; copied question text remains out of ranked PYQ tests
sources.publishPolicy: use as inspiration and coverage map only; produce original practice items and original explanations

sources.title: High-signal SSC CGL books and chapterwise solved-paper references
sources.use: coverage taxonomy, topic ordering, difficulty calibration, and gap detection against purchased/user-provided books or public samples
sources.acquisition: metadata and purchased/user-provided page references only; do not OCR or copy copyrighted books unless the user supplies rights-cleared files
sources.publishPolicy: book text and solved questions are not copied into public notes or ranked tests; use DeepSeek/Mistral/GPT agents to generate original SSC-style practice from topic patterns and then review answers, duplicates, and provenance

sources.title: Local Docker SearXNG and Firecrawl source discovery
sources.use: SearXNG finds candidate source leads; Firecrawl captures source metadata and short excerpts for review
sources.acquisition: metadata and short excerpts only; keep raw full article/book/PDF bodies out of rendered app content
sources.publishPolicy: local crawler output is provenance context, not a license to copy source text

reviewPolicy.rankedPractice: Only reviewed official_open, user_provided, or original_practice items enter ranked tests.
reviewPolicy.webPdf: web_pdf_unverified imports remain in review queue until OCR, answer key, and provenance are checked.
reviewPolicy.copyright: Paid books and third-party coaching banks are not copied into public content.
